description: This PHP class 'LeaveConfigurationService' within the OrangeHRM leave plugin provides methods to access and modify leave-related configuration settings. It extends a core configuration service to handle specific leave management options such as entitlement consumption strategy, work schedule implementation, leave balance inclusion, and leave period status/definition.

classes.name: LeaveConfigurationService
classes.description: Service class for managing leave configuration settings, extending the core ConfigService to include leave-specific configuration keys and getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the leave entitlement consumption algorithm strategy from configuration.

methods.name: getWorkScheduleImplementation
methods.description: Retrieves the work schedule implementation setting related to leave management.

methods.name: includePendingLeaveInBalance
methods.description: Determines whether pending leave should be included in the leave balance calculation.

methods.name: setLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the leave period, such as forced or not.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the leave period.

methods.name: setLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Marks whether the leave period has been set or defined.

methods.name: isLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks if the leave period has been defined.
